variants.name: 750 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Complete, highly varied mixture for guinea pigs: fibres, herbs, vegetables and fruit
  • Contains all necessary nutrients, vitamins and minerals for an optimal condition
  • Fibres, herbs, vegetables and fruit support excellent digestion, good dental care, a shiny coat and perfect health
  • Tasty mixture with extruded morsels for optimal intake and digestion; no pressed pellets
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: derivatives of vegetable origin, cereals, vegetables (carrots 5%*, peppers 4%*, beetroot 2%*, parsnip 1%*), vegetable protein extracts, fruit (banana 1.5%*), seeds, minerals, oils and fats, yeast, FOS, herbs (0.1%), MOS, algae, yucca. *dehydrated, % equivalent before drying.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 14%, crude fat 3.5%, crude fibre 11.5%, crude ash 5%, calcium 0.6%, phosphorus 0.5%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 23500 IU, vitamin D3 850 IU, vitamin E 55 IU, vitamin C 255 mg, iron 69 mg, copper 7 mg, zinc 49 mg, manganese 53 mg, iodine 1.5 mg, selenium 0.14 mg (3b801) + 0.014 mg (3b815).
variants.feeding_instructions: An average daily portion of 35–50 g is recommended, depending on your guinea pig's size and breed. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature Timothy Hay and make sure hay is always available. Refresh drinking water daily. For extra variety, combine with Nature Snacks. Tip for picky eaters: only refill the bowl when it is empty, so every meal stays balanced.
